From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Jane Doe <finance@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Pipeline steward sprint: ownership roster & stage clean sweep

Team —

Quick note ahead of EOD Friday: finance ran the run-rate check and we show ~32% shortfall vs commit for Q3 across the MidMarket book if we don't move deals or reclassify. Before we take this to leadership, I want a rapid stewarding sprint this week to get stage hygiene in-line and lock commits for forecast.

Asks (high priority):
- Each owner (Laura/Marcus) to update CRM stage + next action by EOD Thu (9/2).
- Confirm hard commits vs best-case in the attached tracker (acme_commit_tracking.docx).
- If an external approval or contract signature is pending, ping legal/procurement and drop the expected sign date in the tracker.

I've attached a Q3 snapshot summarizing coverage by ARR band — look at the Opps > $50k tab first. I'll run a reconciliation on Fri morning and pull a final list for the commit call.

Ownership plan:
- Laura: top-of-funnel MidMarket (west) — prioritize 6 accounts flagged in the spreadsheet.
- Marcus: expansion/renewals — focus on the three late-stage deals with legal hold-ups.

Please reply with DONE when your rows are updated. If anything needs an exec escalation (discounts, SLA exceptions), flag inline — I'll coordinate.

Thanks,
Karthik
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: Q3_pipe_snapshot.xlsx (spreadsheet), acme_commit_tracking.docx (doc)

- Nimbus Health: cadence confirmed, but procurement needs SOC2 evidence (I uploaded link to our SOC2 summary in the tracker).
- Helix Labs: buyer unsure on timing; set a follow-up for 9/6.

I'll mark DONE on rows as I finish. If legal needs to expedite for Acme, loop in Markus from Legal — I can get him on a quick call.

Laura

All —

Quick wrap from my side after the stewarding sprint: all assigned rows updated in the tracker. Key outcomes:
- ACME-1234: Laura moved to Contracting; Jane confirmed finance_status = pending_docsign. I attached the proposed DocuSign link in the tracker.
- Two renewal deals (Helix & Nimbus) reclassified from Commit to Upside pending SOC2 + procurement sign — moved to Best Case per policy; I've added explicit notes on expected sign dates.
- Net effect: coverage improves to ~89% of target if Acme signs by 9/8; if not, we plan a pull-forward of smaller expansion deals to protect run-rate.

Next steps (owner mapping):
- Laura: chase Acme DocuSign and secure e-sign by 9/8 (owner: Laura).
- Marcus: confirm SOC2 evidence handoff to Nimbus procurement and track expected sign date (owner: Marcus).
- Karthik: consolidate final list for Fri leadership QBR (owner: Karthik).

If either external team needs a buffer or an SLA exception, ping me and I'll coordinate with GTM ops.

Thanks — marking this thread closed unless there are follow-ups.
